title: A few more of my dreamworlds
content: I've been itching to make another post on here.. Reading everyone's comments & posts on mallworld has been the highlight of my life recently haha- it's sooo interesting to me how similar a lot of our words are. In previous posts I talked about mallworld, schoolworld & hotelworld.. But now I've come to write about some other misc. locations I travel to- please let me know if any of this sounds familiar to you!!! **The Fairylands** The Fairylands is just what I call this location when I write about it in my journal. There's a world I often enter that feels like I'm entering a dark magical forest- not magical in a happy, fun way.. because whenever I "land" here I feel dread & exhaustion most of the time. There's a windy path that curves up the mountain. Although the forest is dark, I often see sparkles of purple/green in small nooks along the mountainside (which is probably why I call it the fairylands). There are some milestones that I pass on my journey up the mountain. I remember seeing an old yellow punchbuggy tucked in a cavern up the mountain.. I remember feeling responsible for getting it down the mountain and struggled driving over the narrow path. I also remember seeing members from the rock band "KISS".. why? I have no clue.. other than my dad used to be a KISS fan and I had KISS barbie dolls that used to creep me the F out. The path ALWAYS ends up back where I began.. that's why when I enter this world I get a sense of "ok let's make this fast" as I run up the hill in hopes for a quick return out. **The Haunted House** There's a haunted house that I end up at occasionally. It's a huge Victorian mansion that's surrounded by a low metal gate.. similar to something you'd see in a horror movie. The yard wraps around the house in a perfect square with the gate protecting it. There are scattered stones in the yard (they aren't tombstones but it still gives off graveyard vibes). There's a large staircase with red velvet carpeting to an exposed 2nd floor. The 2nd floor is safe.. but it's the 3rd that's dangerous. That's where the dead lady sleeps. The dead lady is a tall ghost with dark clothing that peers down over the 3rd floor balcony. Of course there's always a reason for me to go upstairs.. I have to complete some sort of task. Whenever my task is complete and I can locate the side door (ALWAYS the side door), I go running down the concrete steps and run through the yard to safety. **The Amusement Park** These dreams always start with me driving to the amusement park, I don't just "land" there. I'm always on a highway- which to me feels cool but also scary because I don't drive on highways.. it's a huge fear of mine following a bad crash I was in.. but in the dream I feel proud for overcoming my anxiety. The park is part amusement park, part waterpark, part carnival. The carnival is pretty lame, just a few pop up tents. The rides are few and far between. They either look completely run down and dangerous or super high-tech and over the top. I often dream about a rollercoaster at my local amusement park in Allentown, PA (Dorney Park)- "Talon". It looks distorted, naturally. I always find myself right under it, feeling the gust of wind as riders zip past me. I usually ride the flying swings- we go up super high and I can see miles and miles of city (not Allentown though lol, some place more scenic). I have about 5 million more I could write about. These are ALL reoccurring dreams that I've had for yearsss.
